revision_reason: slplab and l2-arctic invalidated: L2 pronunciation assessment models, not native connected speech phone recognizers. Two new candidates added for benchmarking.
research_summary: Phase 2.10 benchmark revised: slplab W2V2 (Korean L2 model) and l2-arctic invalidated due to training target mismatch. Remaining viable candidates: MFA (canonical boundary only, PER=33.8%) and ZIPA (IPA identity, PER=50.0% with mapping loss). Two new candidates pending benchmark: fb/wav2vec2-lv-60-espeak-cv-ft (multilingual phoneme, CommonVoice-trained) and vitouphy/wav2vec2-xls-r-300m-timit-phoneme (TIMIT fine-tuned). No provider selected.

benchmark.limitations: IPA→TIMIT phone mapping imperfect (IPA symbol set >> TIMIT 39 phones); license metadata not verified
Canonical alignment only; cannot detect real weak forms/flapping/deletion. Value is in high-precision phone boundaries, not phone identity.

candidates.notes: Facebook official model. wav2vec2-large-lv60 fine-tuned on CommonVoice for multilingual phoneme recognition. IPA output. Trained on native speaker speech (CommonVoice + LibriVox), not L2 assessment. Research paper: 'Simple and Effective Zero-shot Cross-lingual Phoneme Recognition' (Xu, Baevski, Auli).

XLS-R 300M fine-tuned directly on TIMIT (80/10/10 split). Outputs TIMIT phone set natively (no mapping needed). Reported PER ~8% on TIMIT test. Risk: may overfit to TIMIT read speech and degrade on natural connected speech.

candidates.invalidation_reason: Model designed for Korean L2 English pronunciation assessment (mispronunciation detection), NOT native English connected speech phone recognition. Low PER on TIMIT (31.5%) is coincidental: TIMIT read speech overlaps with L2 model training distribution. In real connected speech, would likely misclassify native weak forms as pronunciation errors.

benchmark.note: PER retained for reference only, not used for selection

candidates.invalidation_reason: Fine-tuned on L2-Arctic (non-native English learner speech). Same fundamental issue as slplab: L2 pronunciation assessment model, not native connected speech recognizer. PER=97% confirms output space completely mismatched with TIMIT native annotations.
